requirements.evidence: Default map + range fallback in app/Models/Queue.php:24-52 (DEFAULT_PREFIX_MAP, defaultPrefixFor with <=0 N, >=20 E, else P); prefixForPriority custom-first at Queue.php:57-71; saving hook normalizes []->null and validates (Queue.php:30-38) with canonical-key regex '/\A(?:0|[1-9][0-9]*)\z/', '/\A[A-Z]\z/' value check and effective-prefix uniqueness including uncovered 0/10/20 defaults (Queue.php:89-131); map not added to #[Fillable]. Migration adds issue_date nullable, backfills DATE(issued_at), makes NOT NULL, swaps unique index, has down() (2026_10_29_054028...:15-49). Ticket::nextCode filters by queue + issue_date, per-prefix regex '([0-9]{3,})', skips malformed/legacy codes (Ticket.php:36-55). IssueTicket reads now() once and uses it for code day, issued_at and issue_date (IssueTicket.php:27-29, 48-52, 62-63). Factory derives issue_date from issued_at or today and allocates by priority/day, keeps explicit codes (TicketFactory.php:44-85). UpdateQueue gains ?array $priorityPrefixMap, null=unchanged, []=clear, invalid -> ValidationException keyed priority_prefix_map before any mutation (UpdateQueue.php:21-38, 73-75). Docs and CHANGELOG updated.

conventions.evidence: Map changes go through the UpdateQueue action with Gate authorization first (UpdateQueue.php:23); model-level InvalidArgumentException as the task requires; $fillable deliberately left without priority_prefix_map; migrations follow the generated format with reversible down(); docs/business-rules.md, docs/database-schema.md and CHANGELOG.md ([Unreleased] Added) kept in sync; PHPDoc on new public methods (Queue.php:42-93, Ticket.php:28-35). Code style matches siblings.

security.evidence: priority_prefix_map is not mass-assignable (#[Fillable] unchanged, tested by 'does not mass assign the priority prefix map'); UpdateQueue authorizes before validating (tested by 'authorizes before validating the priority prefix map'); strict anchored regexes with \z reject trailing-newline keys/values (tests 'trailing newline key/value'). No UI/Livewire surface touched.

tests.evidence: Existing IssueTicketTest cases migrated A->N without weakening, plus new cases for independent prefixes, range fallback, custom map, next-day restart at 23:59:59/00:00:01, single clock instant, legacy A codes, <3-digit codes, factory priority/date allocation and explicit codes. New QueuePriorityPrefixTest covers defaults, partial map, cast, empty->null normalization on every save, mass-assignment, a dataset of invalid/valid maps, existing-queue save validation, UpdateQueue update/preserve/clear, invalid map leaves queue unchanged, unauthorized call, schema/index and DB-level daily uniqueness. Missing: a test of the migration backfill of existing rows; 'issues codes with the custom map from the factory' duplicates an IssueTicketTest case and does not use the factory despite its name.

simplicity.evidence: Generally lean and reuses nextCode/Gate. Some unnecessary code: the string-key branch in prefixForPriority (Queue.php:65-69) is unreachable because PHP arrays already canonicalize numeric-string keys to ints; the factory adds a branch that rewrites issued_at's date to match an explicit issue_date (TicketFactory.php:55-65), beyond what was asked; nextCode loads all codes of the day for the queue rather than narrowing by prefix.

readability.evidence: Clear names and comments (e.g. IssueTicket.php:25-27, Ticket.php:28-35). Minor: unused $prefix loop variable in 'foreach (self::DEFAULT_PREFIX_MAP as $priority => $prefix)' (Queue.php:122-126), misleading test name 'issues codes with the custom map from the factory', and the dead string-key fallback with a comment that suggests it is needed.

scope.evidence: All changes (models, actions, factories, two migrations, docs, changelog, tests) serve the task; no UI, totem API or ordering changes.

issues.explanation: The backfill of issue_date from DATE(issued_at) for pre-existing rows and the down() path are not exercised by any test; only the resulting schema/index is asserted.

nextCode plucks every code of the queue for the day and regex-scans them, and uses whereDate() on a DATE column (wrapping it in DATE() on MariaDB, defeating the index) instead of a plain where plus a prefix LIKE filter.
The string-key fallback in prefixForPriority is unreachable because PHP converts numeric-string array keys to integers.
Loop variable $prefix from DEFAULT_PREFIX_MAP is unused; the loop calls defaultPrefixFor($priority) instead of using the value it already has.
Test named 'issues codes with the custom map from the factory' uses IssueTicket, not the factory, and duplicates 'uses the queue custom prefix map' in IssueTicketTest.
Rewriting issued_at to match an explicitly supplied issue_date is extra behavior beyond the task's 'issue_date defaults to the date of issued_at'.

review.summary: The change implements priority-based prefixes (N/P/E defaults with range fallbacks), a validated, non-mass-assignable per-queue prefix map managed via UpdateQueue, and per-prefix daily sequences backed by a new issue_date column and a reworked unique index, with docs, changelog and extensive tests. All requirements and contract points are met with sound authorization and validation; only minor issues remain (no migration backfill test, small dead code, a non-index-friendly whereDate query), so it is approvable with nits.
